sentry.name: Sprout Sentry
sentry.desc: Shoots peas at the closest pest. Cheap and steady (leaf).

branches.name: Triple Sunflower
branches.desc: Three heads: shoots 3 peas at once at 3 different pests. Great against crowds.

branches.name: Sniper Sunflower
branches.desc: Huge range and giant shots that pierce armor and spot Camo pests anywhere.

mortar.name: Puffball Mortar
mortar.desc: Lobs exploding puffballs at crowds. Blast SHATTERs chilled pests!

branches.name: Cluster Puffball
branches.desc: Every puffball bursts into 4 mini bombs. Wipes out swarms!

branches.name: Stun Shroom
branches.desc: Bigger booms that stun pests for a moment.

fern.name: Frost Fern
fern.desc: Chills and slows every pest around it. Sets up SHATTER and MELT.

branches.name: Blizzard Fern
branches.desc: A giant snowstorm: much bigger area and the strongest slow.

branches.name: Frostbite Fern
branches.desc: Bites 3x harder, and every 4th pulse freezes pests solid.

zap.name: Zap Thistle
zap.desc: Lightning that jumps between pests. OVERLOADs burning pests.

branches.name: Storm Thistle
branches.desc: Lightning jumps to 9 pests and reaches further.

branches.name: Thunder Thistle
branches.desc: One mighty bolt: triple damage and a short stun.

thorns.name: Thorn Patch
thorns.desc: Trap on the path: hurts every pest walking through it.

branches.name: Bramble Snare
branches.desc: Sticky vines slow every pest walking through.

branches.name: Poison Ivy
branches.desc: Bigger patch, and pests stay poisoned for 4 seconds after they leave it.

bomb.name: Seed Bomb
bomb.desc: Trap on the path: one big BOOM when a pest steps on it.

pot.name: Bloom Pot
pot.desc: Helper: during waves it grows acorns and Sun orbs, and towers near it fire 15% faster.

branches.name: Golden Harvest
branches.desc: Grows twice as many acorns, and a bigger Sun orb.

branches.name: Sunshine Pot
branches.desc: Towers near it fire 35% faster, and heroes standing by it 15% faster.

sap.name: Sap Pitcher
sap.desc: Trap on the path: sticky sap slows pests, washes off Camo, and fire & blast hurt them 20% more.

branches.name: Super Sticky
branches.desc: Much stickier: a big slow that lasts 6 seconds.

branches.name: Fire Sap
branches.desc: Fire and blast hurt sapped pests 45% more.

gust.name: Gust Blossom
gust.desc: Every 4 seconds a big puff of wind blows pests back along the trail. A great last guard by the tree!

branches.name: Whirlwind
branches.desc: Blows back every pest in range, farther.

branches.name: Dizzy Gust
branches.desc: Puffs more often and leaves pests dizzy (stunned) for a moment.
